name: How long does a typical small paint touch-up take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical small paint touch-up take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a small paint touch-up largely depends on the scope of work and the drying time of the paint. Most minor touch-ups can be completed within a few hours, from preparation to final application. However, if multiple coats are required or if the paint needs specific drying conditions, the project might extend over a day. We aim to complete projects efficiently while ensuring a quality finish that blends seamlessly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most small paint touch-ups take a few hours, though some may extend over a day if multiple coats or specific drying times are needed.
